title: Drawllab
description: Created for BrainStation's 2021 Capstone, this drawing application allows you to doodle and play around with wireframes.

title: Voluble
description: Voluble is a full-stack chat application created to review user authentication, real-time updates with web sockets, and database management. Create an account, upload a profile picture, change your theme, and chat with friends instantly!

title: QR Code Generator
description: Generate QR Codes from any text or URL in black and white or custom color schemes.

title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Enjoy a quick game or five of rock paper scissors! This website features a responsive mobile to desktop layout and dark and light modes that default to system preferences.

title: Pokemon Town
description: A website created for BrainStation's August 2021 hackathon and updated with mobile-first responsive design and new functionalities in 2025. This website uses the pokeAPI to show off a selection of pokemon you would expect to run into in a handful of towns in the Kanto Region.
